url.title: Url
url.description: Repository publishing the catalog: a public https:// URL on any host, an SSH URL for a private one, or the absolute path of a folder on this server holding an exported catalog.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Branch or tag to track. Defaults to 'main'.

local_name.title: Local Name
local_name.description: Directory name to install the catalog under. Defaults to the repository name.

ssh_key_path.title: Ssh Key Path
ssh_key_path.description: Private key for an SSH repository. Defaults to the admin user's key.

ca_bundle_path.title: Ca Bundle Path
ca_bundle_path.description: CA bundle to verify the server's certificate against, for a self-hosted https repository whose certificate this host does not already trust.
